query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'APPROVED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PARTIAL')) AND ((r."QUANTITY" > r."RECEIVED") AND (r."UNIT_MINOR" > 0)) THEN (0 + ((r."QUANTITY" - r."RECEIVED") * r."UNIT_MINOR")) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."SUPPLIER") = RTRIM(:p_supplier)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::PO_OPEN_VALUE" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "SUPPLIER" NVARCHAR(20), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "QUANTITY" BIGINT, "RECEIVED" BIGINT, "UNIT_MINOR" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_supplier NVARCHAR(255),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'APPROVED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'PARTIAL')) AND ((r."QUANTITY" > r."RECEIVED") AND (r."UNIT_MINOR" > 0)) THEN (0 + ((r."QUANTITY" - r."RECEIVED") * r."UNIT_MINOR")) ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."SUPPLIER") = RTRIM(:p_supplier)));
END;

semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
